duas.title: Acceptance of Deeds
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana taqabbal minna innaka antas Samee'ul Aleem
duas.translation: Our Lord! Accept (this service) from us. Indeed, You are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

duas.title: Good in This World and Hereafter
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan waqina 'adhaban-nar
duas.translation: Our Lord! Give us in this world that which is good and in the Hereafter that which is good, and save us from the torment of the Fire!

duas.title: Patience and Steadfastness
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana afrigh 'alayna sabran wa thabbit aqdamana wansurna 'alal-qawmil-kafirin
duas.translation: Our Lord! Pour upon us patience and plant firmly our feet and give us victory over the disbelieving people.

duas.title: Do Not Burden Us
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا
duas.transliteration: Rabbana la tu'akhidhna in nasina aw akhta'na, Rabbana wa la tahmil 'alayna isran kama hamaltahu 'alal-ladhina min qablina
duas.translation: Our Lord! Do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred. Our Lord! And do not lay upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us.

duas.title: Guide Our Hearts
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْوَهَّابُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana la tuzigh quloobana ba'da idh hadaytana wa hab lana mil-ladunka rahmah, innaka antal-Wahhab
duas.translation: Our Lord! Let not our hearts deviate (from the truth) after You have guided us, and grant us mercy from You. Truly, You are the Bestower.

duas.title: Forgive Our Sins
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَإِسْرَافَنَا فِي أَمْرِنَا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana-ghfir lana dhunuubana wa israfana fi amrina wa thabbit aqdamana wansurna 'alal-qawmil-kafirin
duas.translation: Our Lord! Forgive us our sins and our transgressions, establish our feet firmly, and give us victory over the disbelieving people.

duas.title: Grant Us Muslim Progeny
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَاجْعَلْنَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ لَكَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِنَا أُمَّةً مُّسْلِمَةً لَّكَ وَأَرِنَا مَنَاسِكَنَا وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana waj'alna Muslimayni laka wa min dhurriyyatina ummatan Muslimatan laka wa arina manasikana wa tub 'alayna innaka antat-Tawwabur-Rahim
duas.translation: Our Lord! Make us both submissive unto You and of our offspring a nation submissive unto You, and show us our rites and accept our repentance. Truly, You are the One Who accepts repentance, the Most Merciful.

duas.title: Protection from the Fire
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana innana amanna faghfir lana dhunuubana wa qina 'adhaaban-nar
duas.translation: Our Lord! We have indeed believed, so forgive us our sins and save us from the punishment of the Fire.
